title: Paystride Save Saving-Streak Bonus Schedule
content:
A Paystride Save saving streak is a run of consecutive card pay periods in each of which the worker's deposits into savings reach a set amount. The bonus figures by tier are:

| Tier | Bonus credited when a streak completes | Consecutive card pay periods that complete a streak | Deposits in a pay period needed for it to count | Streak bonuses allowed in any rolling 365 days | Calendar days after a bonus during which falling below the floor takes it back | Balance below which a recent bonus is taken back |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Paystride Save Starter | $0.00 | 0 | $0.00 | 0 | 0 | $0.00 |
| Paystride Save Builder | $5.00 | 4 | $10.00 | 2 | 30 | $25.00 |
| Paystride Save Boost | $10.00 | 4 | $10.00 | 3 | 30 | $25.00 |
| Paystride Save Growth | $10.00 | 6 | $25.00 | 4 | 30 | $50.00 |
| Paystride Save Premier | $15.00 | 6 | $25.00 | 4 | 30 | $50.00 |
| Paystride Save Elite | $20.00 | 6 | $25.00 | 6 | 30 | $50.00 |

## Notes

- Paystride Save Starter carries a zero bonus, with every streak figure at zero.
- Builder and Boost streaks are 4 consecutive card pay periods of at least $10.00 in deposits each; Growth, Premier and Elite streaks are 6 consecutive card pay periods of at least $25.00 each.
- The number of bonuses allowed is counted over any rolling 365 days: 2 on Builder, 3 on Boost, 4 on Growth and Premier, and 6 on Elite.
- On every tier that pays a bonus, the take-back period is 30 calendar days after the bonus; the balance floor is $25.00 on Builder and Boost and $50.00 on Growth, Premier and Elite.

## A tier comparison (hypothetical)

A worker whose deposits into savings reach $12.00 in each of 4 consecutive card pay periods meets the Builder and Boost streak figures, since $12.00 reaches $10.00 and 4 periods are the streak length there; the same deposits do not meet the Growth, Premier or Elite figures, where each period needs $25.00 and a streak runs 6 periods.
